name: Not Having Children
overview: Scripture acknowledges the blessing and heritage of children as gifts from the Lord, emphasizing the joy and godly purpose found in raising offspring (Psalms 113:9; Psalms 127:3; Malachi 2:15). Yet, the Bible also recognizes those who do not have children, including eunuchs by birth, by circumstance, or by choice for the sake of the kingdom of heaven, affirming their unique calling and value (Matthew 19:12). Furthermore, Galatians 4:27 encourages rejoicing in barrenness, highlighting that spiritual fruitfulness and God's purposes transcend natural parenthood.
